scope: Whole-lap Las Vegas scenery and night lighting; track branch, no worktree. Road alignment, widths, contact, handling and camera preserved.

reference.registration: Corners, landmarks and map stations; playback includes time changes/cuts, so elapsed video time is not used as lap distance.
reference.limits: Mapped footprints with original architectural reconstruction. Vegetation, venue dimensions and luminance are visual estimates. No reference-video pixels or game meshes ship.

root_causes: Planting was restricted to stations below700m or above4650m; the opening sequence, Koval, Sphere and Sands had none.
Fixed18m building-midpoint culling removed the entire Wynn retail/Plaza footprint despite adequate actual road clearance.
Ordinary low-rise buildings used repeated hotel window grids and lacked street-level glazing, balconies, canopies and venue structures.
48m fixture spacing and dark material attenuation produced dull surfaces; the first24m fixture trial clipped the light field and made the road uniformly pale.

changes.coverage: All6201m in nine contiguous sectors, not a selection of landmark views.
changes.buildings: Retained Wynn Plaza footprint, stone shop frontage and curved digital monument; Venetian Expo, Ellis Island motel/casino, Harrahs, Casino Royale, Platinum, Westin, Grand Chateau, Signature, Polo Towers and small Strip retail profiles. Attached wordmarks on the buildings.
changes.hospitality: Left-side glazed balcony gallery2210–2830m and seating2850–3230m; opening grandstand2070–2210m; roofed paddock stand and garages1660–1980m.
changes.vegetation: Solid trunks/branches and spatial leaf clusters using the existing original Interlagos atlas. Fuller25-frond procedural palms; building, venue and paved-area exclusions.
changes.lighting: 24m fixture spacing;8.5m field falloff radius,0.07 diffuse bounce,3.8 neutral flood intensity,0.24 skylight fill. Private Vegas material copies refresh on rebuild.
changes.displays: Original warm red/orange/gold Sphere LED ribbons, orange/black Wynn Plaza display and magenta Harmon Corner facade display.
